summary: Carry a gate's chain-authored `verdict` onto the tick verdict's gate result and onto the gate-revert record, beside `message` and copied no further.
tests: a gate's verdict lands on the tick verdict's gate row verbatim
a gate-revert prior-attempt record carries the failing gate's verdict beside its message
pins: a gate that returned no verdict leaves no verdict on its tick verdict row
acceptance: a chain reads a failing gate's own reason off the persisted verdict and off the gate-revert record without parsing `message`.
notes: `skipped` is the shape to copy: the dispatcher spreads it conditionally at each gate-result site, and tests/Dispatcher.test.ts already pairs a present case with an absent one. The section names those two persistence sites only — `TickResult.gateResults` erases `details` and `skipped` today and stays as it is. The declared-fact-fields verdict test enumerates the allowed keys.

edit.description: neutralize the declared keys' values between stage 1 and stage 2
the declared key, the undeclared key, the unresolvable span

summary: Let a phase declare which promptArgs keys are data, and neutralize every inline-exec span in those values before stage 2 scans the substituted text.
tests: a declared data key's value carries an inline-exec span into the prompt without executing it
a declared data key's neutralized span still shows the agent the command text
a declared data key carrying an unresolvable span renders instead of refusing the tick
pins: an undeclared key's value carrying an inline-exec span is still evaluated
acceptance: a phase naming a key in `promptDataKeys` renders content it did not author with no span executable, every undeclared key unchanged.
notes: The neutralizing transform itself is spec-silent. Keep the command text visible and the sigil inert: dropping the span would be the silent degradation `engineering.md` *Loud or nothing* names, over content the prompt exists to show. `renderPrompt` already takes `phase`, so nothing new threads through, and the reserved `FLUME_DIR` is engine-authored — it needs no declaration.

edit.description: export the factory and its options type

summary: Add the package's chain factory: a complete Chain from one declaration — three plan slices and the fanout build phase, each with its prompt, gates and handoff.
tests: the factory returns the three plan slices and the build phase from a declaration
a plan slice the declaration does not enable is absent from the returned chain
the returned build phase is fanout and carries the declaration's fence
each returned phase names its prompt by an absolute path the package ships
the factory passes the declared supervisor policy to the chain whole
every placeholder the package's prompts name is supplied by the phase the factory returns for it
each returned phase runs the handoff the declaration names for it, else the package's default
acceptance: harness/chain.ts turns a parsed declaration into a Chain whose phases, prompts, gates and handoff are the package's.
notes: The assembly point: it wires the gates, the judge, the handoff, the windows, the prompt args and the entry extension, and carries setup, agents and slots through. .flume/chain.ts becomes this factory over .flume/declaration.ts at the cutover — an interactive chore(flume):, never build's (the cutover ruling, 6286ba8). Declared data keys and the gate verdict field are ratified (3572fe5) and land before that cutover, not here.
